end.summary:
Discussed how festivals vary across regions and may be celebrated differently.
Reviewed that harvest festivals are linked to crops becoming ready.
Kavya named Assam and Onam, and identified Punjab for a harvest festival.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha used board examples and questions to practise regional differences and harvest timing. Kavya gave three unaided responses about regional celebrations and correctly linked harvest festivals with ready crops; an early seed-sowing answer was later corrected to crop readiness. At home, ask Kavya to name two harvest festivals and say one way their celebrations differ.
